what: 대사 자막층 en — 새 1편 「처음 만나요」 v11(대본 03_episodes/L01/L01-00/L01-00-01_first-meet/L01-00-01_script.md) · 언어부 10-22 · 제미나이 검토 + AI 판단으로 확정(대표님 10-22 · 원어민 검수 없음 · 남는 건 앱 신고 단추)

subtitles.t: Hello, everyone. I am a Korean teacher. My family name is "한", and my given name is "국어". Nice to meet you.
From now on, you and I will study together, one on one.
We will start from the very basics of Hangul consonants and vowels, then everyday Korean, all the way to Korean test prep. We will do it all together.
Just like a baby learns to talk, listen in Korean, then speak and write it yourself.
If you only watch, you only get better at watching. You get better by doing it yourself.
Research shows that words you say out loud are remembered better and longer.
You can also learn while playing games.
In this app, from start to finish, you and I learn by talking to each other.
Next time, we will learn what Hangul looks like. It was nice to meet you today. See you next time.
